fields.description: Deploy to staging has been failing since this morning. Pipeline goes red at the migration step. Blocking the 4.2 release.

comments.body: Is this the same as the failure we saw in August? That one was a connection pool thing.
Don't think so. That was on the reporting DB. This is checkout.
+1 we are blocked on this too for the promo work
Narrowed it down. The migration runner is timing out but the migration itself completes. So the pipeline thinks it failed when it didn't.
Talked to infra. They bumped the RDS instance last week and the migration lock behaviour changed.

*Fixed.* Root cause: the migration runner had a hardcoded 30s timeout and after the RDS upgrade the ALTER TABLE on checkout_orders takes ~45s because the table grew past 12M rows. Raised the timeout to 300s in {code}deploy/migrate.sh{code} and added a --lock-timeout flag so it fails loudly instead of hanging. Deployed to staging, pipeline is green. Longer term we should run large migrations out of band, raised PLAT-2310 for that.

fields.summary: Run large migrations out of band
fields.description: Follow-up from PLAT-2291. Migrations on tables over ~10M rows should not run inside the deploy pipeline. Need a separate runner with its own timeout and a way to gate the deploy on completion.

comments.body: Picking this up next sprint unless someone objects.

Does the validator know about captures at all, or is it comparing against the authorised amount?
It was comparing against authorised. Fixed in PR #1184 - validator now reads captured_amount from the ledger instead. Added a regression test for the partial capture case.
